solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Transfer of power that might suggest a stable situation now?

definitions.meaning: a handover from one government or team to the next

definitions.text: might suggest a stable situation now
definitions.meaning: split as two words, the phrase says change is finished, so things are now settled and steady

explanation.surface: A political commentator wonders whether a handover of power means calm has finally arrived.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the answer into CHANGE plus OVER: once change is over, things are stable.
explanation.definitionFit: A switch of control from one party or person to another is called by this name, as at a shift's end.

clue.text: State officer leading men — trouble ensues

parts.note: COL is short for colonel, an army officer
OR stands for other ranks, soldiers who are not officers
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: In some state, an officer leads his troops and trouble follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Colorado is one of the fifty US states, in the Rocky Mountains.

clue.text: Management isn't unfortunately overwhelmed by a feeling of esteem

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means swamped, so the jumbled letters are engulfed by the esteem word

parts.note: admiration is a feeling of high regard or esteem

indicators.note: unfortunately signals the letters of isn't land in an unlucky jumble

parts.note: the apostrophe drops out, leaving four letters

explanation.surface: Staff complain the management, sadly, is not held in high regard.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'isn't' is ignored; 'unfortunately' scrambles its four letters before they are swallowed by the esteem word.
explanation.definitionFit: Running an organisation, or the people who run it, can be called management, a synonym.

clue.text: Information about lake in valley

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the information word goes round the lake letter

parts.note: gen is informal British slang for information
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A guidebook offers facts about a lake lying in a valley.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow valley, especially in Scotland, goes by this name.

clue.text: Pleasure trip's a revelation

definitions.meaning: a short excursion or day out for fun
the public exposure of someone's secret, such as their sexuality

explanation.surface: A day trip turns out to be eye-opening.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an excursion for pleasure and the act of exposing a hidden fact about someone.

clue.text: Girl in garden going to church to give testimony

indicators.note: going to adds the next piece on the end
in puts the girl inside the garden

parts.note: Eden is the biblical garden
Vi is a girl's name, short for Violet
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A girl strolling in the garden heads off to church to bear witness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Girl in garden' tempts EVE, but the girl is VI, placed in EDEN.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, this word means to show or attest, much as a witness does in court.

clue.text: Victoria and others love being into drugs

indicators.note: being into means placed inside, so the love letter goes into the drugs

parts.note: statins are cholesterol-lowering drugs
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Queen Victoria and her circle are said to be fond of narcotics.
explanation.walkthrough: Victoria is a London railway terminus, so she and others are railway stops, not a queen and courtiers.
explanation.definitionFit: London Victoria is a major railway terminus, an example of a place where trains stop.

clue.text: Wicked Satan blundered, that's clear

indicators.note: wicked suggests the letters of Satan blundered are corrupted into a new order

explanation.surface: It is plain that the wicked Devil made a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Something comprehensible or intelligible is clear in meaning, so these are synonyms.

clue.text: Insects in B & B and suchlike

definitions.meaning: the letter B spelt out in full, so B and B and other such letters, taken as a plural

explanation.surface: Insects are found in a bed and breakfast and similar lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: B & B looks like bed and breakfast, but read as two letters B, each one spelt out.
explanation.definitionFit: Bees are winged insects, and the plural name of the letter B is spelt the same way.

clue.text: The French doctor attached to hospital department is brilliant

parts.note: la is a French word for 'the'
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department

explanation.surface: A French physician working in a hospital department is praised as outstanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Lambent means softly glowing or flickering, and figuratively dazzling, so it is a synonym of shining or brilliant.

clue.text: Spirited tennis played with energy

indicators.note: the letters of tennis are played about, worked into a new order

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A lively game of tennis played with plenty of vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirited and fervent mean much the same: full of strong feeling and force.

clue.text: Noise of pig not good — weak animal

indicators.note: not tells us to leave out the letter for good from the pig's noise

parts.note: a pig's noise is a grunt

explanation.surface: A farmer notes that a feeble squeal from a pig suggests a sickly animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The smallest, weakest piglet of a litter is called by this name, and so is any undersized creature.

clue.text: One of former generation given cane when naughty, leading to anxiety

indicators.note: leading to puts the first piece in front of the next
naughty means misbehaving, so the letters of cane are knocked out of order

parts.note: stress is worry or anxiety

explanation.surface: A grandmother of old wielded the cane on naughty children, causing them anxiety.
explanation.definitionFit: A female forebear is a woman from an earlier generation of the family.

clue.text: Lust revealed by rude sir excessively

indicators.note: revealed by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A rude gentleman's crude excess betrays his lechery.
explanation.definitionFit: Lust is strong craving, especially sexual longing, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Note to self maybe about someone to look after the kids?

parts.note: re means about or concerning

parts.words: someone to look after the kids
parts.note: a childminder, or minder, looks after children

explanation.surface: A parent jots a memo about finding a babysitter.
explanation.definitionFit: A memo jotted to jog the memory, as a note to self, is a prompt of this kind.

clue.text: Particular little house that's comfy inside? The opposite

indicators.note: rather than house going inside comfy, the opposite: comfy goes outside the abbreviation for house

parts.note: comfy and cosy both mean snug
HO is a short form of house

explanation.surface: A fussy buyer wants a small cottage that feels snug within.
explanation.walkthrough: Read plainly, the house would go inside the comfy word; 'The opposite' flips that relationship, so the comfy word wraps round the little house instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Being particular means being fussy and hard to please, which is a synonym.

clue.text: Foreign city barrier — look, river penetrates it!

indicators.note: penetrates means goes into, so the look and river letters enter the barrier

parts.note: a fence is a barrier
lo is an old word meaning look or behold
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A traveller exclaims at a foreign city's wall pierced by a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Florence is an Italian city on the Arno, so a city abroad from a British view.

clue.text: In a meeting again? Endure it with difficulty

indicators.note: with difficulty suggests the letters of endure it are forced into a strained new order

explanation.surface: Facing yet another meeting, one must grit one's teeth and bear it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a meeting again' looks like office drudgery, but means being brought back together.
explanation.definitionFit: People brought together once more after a separation are joined again, so a meeting again fits.

clue.text: Cardinal is proper gangster

parts.note: prim means stiffly correct or proper
Al Capone was the famous Chicago gangster

explanation.surface: A cardinal of the Church is revealed as both strait-laced and a mobster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cardinal' suggests a churchman, but here it is the adjective meaning chief or fundamental.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinal as an adjective means fundamental or of first importance, as does primal.

clue.text: Car's condition at back of garage

indicators.note: at places the condition piece next to the letter from the garage
back of picks out the final letter of garage

parts.note: state means condition, as in a state of repair

explanation.surface: A motorist checks what state the car is in at the back of the garage.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate car is the British name for a station wagon, a car with a long rear load space.

clue.text: Command from chief bringing ambassador in

indicators.note: bringing a thing in means taking it inside
in completes bringing ... in, putting the ambassador inside the chief word

parts.note: best means foremost or chief
HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: An order comes from the boss to admit the ambassador.
explanation.definitionFit: A behest is an order or instruction, as in 'at the king's behest', so a synonym.

clue.text: The curves of Ms Blanchett, name seen with the stars

parts.note: Cate Blanchett is the Australian actress
Aries is a constellation and sign of the zodiac, so one of the stars

explanation.surface: A gossip writer admires Cate Blanchett's figure as her name appears among the film stars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The curves of Ms Blanchett' suggests her figure; 'of' is only a link, and the definition is mathematical.
explanation.definitionFit: A catenary is the curve formed by a chain or cable hanging freely between two supports.

clue.text: Cold animal gets garment

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
an ape is an animal

explanation.surface: A shivering creature is given clothing to keep warm.
explanation.definitionFit: A cape is a sleeveless cloak worn over the shoulders, a kind of outer clothing.

clue.text: God of old confronting Babel

indicators.note: confronting means facing, so the first piece stands in front of the second

parts.note: Babel is a confused noise of voices, a din

explanation.surface: An ancient deity faces the builders of the Tower of Babel.
explanation.definitionFit: He is the chief god of Norse mythology, father of Thor.

clue.text: Home worker displays endless glamour

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the glamour word is dropped

parts.note: charm and glamour both mean allure

explanation.surface: A homeworker shows unending allure.
explanation.definitionFit: A char, short for charwoman, is a British cleaner who does housework in others' homes.

clue.text: Body-builder inept or stupid

indicators.note: stupid suggests the letters of inept or are muddled into a senseless order

explanation.surface: A gym-goer who pumps iron is dismissed as clumsy or dim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Body-builder' looks like a gym muscleman, but it is the nutrient that builds body tissue.
explanation.definitionFit: This nutrient builds and repairs the body's muscles and tissues, a playful description.

clue.text: Show one component at back of old hospital

indicators.note: at back of places the component piece after the others

parts.note: ex means former or old, as in ex-wife
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
I is the Roman numeral one
a bit is a part or component

explanation.surface: A museum puts on display one piece found at the back of a disused hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhibit is to display or put on view, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Special piece of paper one such as I will be given by Principal

indicators.note: this puts the principal piece next to the first

parts.note: the letter I is an example of a letter of the alphabet
a school principal is its head

explanation.surface: A student is told a special document will be handed over by the principal.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper printed at the top with a name and address is stationery made specially for correspondence.
